verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents read and modify collections, requests, environments, and teams, enabling natural-language/agentic operation via a connected AI agent rather than native NL input in the UI itself. missing for 10: no evidence of built-in natural-language command parsing within the app UI itself, no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability, and no examples of complex NL workflows being executed end-to-end.
